name: create_kotlin_sealed_result
description: Models a parse result as a sealed interface with exhaustive handling
prompts: Create src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/Duration.kt (package com.optarena.app) that parses human duration strings like "90s", "15m", "2h" into seconds, modeling the outcome as a sealed hierarchy: a sealed interface ParseResult with data class Ok(val seconds: Long) and data class Invalid(val reason: String) implementing it. Provide object DurationParser with fun parse(input: String): ParseResult - trims the input; accepts a positive integer followed by exactly one unit character s/m/h (seconds/minutes/hours); anything else (empty, missing unit, unknown unit, non-numeric, zero or negative number) returns Invalid with a non-empty reason. Also provide fun describe(result: ParseResult): String using an exhaustive when - Ok(n) becomes "<n> seconds" and Invalid(reason) becomes "invalid: <reason>".
